name: good-prompts
description: Good Prompts: landing page, waitlist and rewrite service (Vercel), plus the Chrome extension

scripts.check: node --check dev-server.js && node --check lib/db.js && node --check lib/handlers.js && node --check lib/rewrite-engine.js && node --check extension/background.js && node --check extension/content.js && node --check extension/options.js
scripts.build:extension: node -e "const v=require('./extension/manifest.json').version;const {execSync}=require('child_process');execSync('rm -rf dist && mkdir -p dist');execSync('cd extension && zip -r -X -q ../dist/good-prompts-'+v+'.zip . -x dev-test.html -x .DS_Store -x \"*/.DS_Store\"');console.log('dist/good-prompts-'+v+'.zip')"
